arStrings.szText: Just days ago. Oh, you should have seen it. People from all over came to see him. Survivors from the fall of Caldeum and Guulrahn. Akarat laid his hands on them, and they were healed of their wounds!
Excited--eager to tell of her witnessing Akarat's greatness. Pronunciations: Kal-dee-um, Gull-rahn, Ah-kah-raht
